blocks.html: Cost Per Lead (CPL) is a marketing metric that measures how much a company spends to generate a single qualified lead.

CPL is a key indicator of marketing efficiency, helping businesses evaluate how cost-effectively they are attracting potential customers. It is widely used in lead generation campaigns to assess performance across different channels and optimize budget allocation.
CPL is calculated using the following formula:

items.html: (Total Marketing Campaign Costs ÷ Number of Leads Generated)

blocks.html: Helps optimize marketing spend and improve efficiency
Supports better campaign planning and budgeting
By analyzing CPL, businesses can determine which campaigns and channels deliver the most cost-effective leads.
If a company spends ₹50,000 on a digital campaign and generates 500 leads, the CPL is ₹100 per lead.
Cost Per Lead is a crucial metric for understanding the effectiveness of lead generation efforts. By reducing CPL while maintaining lead quality, businesses can scale their pipeline more efficiently.
